findings.title: No EMC filtering near J401
findings.description: Connector J401 (SERVO_AMP2) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J401. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J401

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (65×30mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1099 MHz; (2,0) at 2199 MHz; (0,1) at 2382 MHz; (1,1) at 2624 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: U301 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U301 (AP63205WU-7) switching at 0.5 MHz has 117 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 60-176). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U301. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U301 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band

findings.title: U301 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band
findings.description: U301 (AP63205WU-7) switching at 0.5 MHz has 257 harmonics in the 88-216 MHz band (harmonics 176-432). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U301. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U301 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band

findings.title: U301 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band
findings.description: U301 (AP63205WU-7) switching at 0.5 MHz has 1489 harmonics in the 216-960 MHz band (harmonics 432-1920). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U301. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U301 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band

findings.title: U301 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U301 (AP63205WU-7) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.
findings.summary: U301 harmonic envelope

findings.title: differential diff pair skew approaching limit
findings.description: Differential pair SPK_P/SPK_N has 8.4mm length mismatch (45.8 ps skew). differential limit is 50 ps.
findings.recommendation: Match trace lengths to within 25 ps (4.6mm). Use length-matched serpentine routing.
findings.summary: differential diff pair skew approaching limit
